description: Sprint 2A production-validation benchmark. 12 companies x 3 question categories = 36 queries. Designed to expand to 100-150 by adding more companies/categories without changing the schema.

categories.core_thesis: Core bull/bear thesis at current valuation
categories.decision_threshold: What operating metric would break the thesis, and at what level
categories.structural_risk: Primary structural risk, what is priced in, and what forces a re-rating
